ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central lobes and 35% low-intensity dark pixels distributed along the margins and central hinge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the central 60% of both lobes. Low-intensity dark margins border the trailing edges and distal tips. A distinct, isolated low-intensity circular blob is visible on the mid-medial left lobe. Dense, irregular dark-and-white mottling is present at the peduncle insertion area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a measured pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees; depth is roughly 15% of the total vertical height of the fluke in the field of view.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serrations across the entire trailing edge. Amplitude of variations is highest at the distal tips, showing sharp peaks and valleys, transitioning to lower-frequency undulations as the edge approaches the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge exhibits a primarily convex curve from the median notch extending to the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of high-intensity white circular pixel groups at the distal tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple low-intensity, roughly horizontal parallel lines on the surface of the right lobe; sparse vertical linear disruptions on the lower portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct circular dark lesion or pigment anomaly is located on the interior portion of the left lobe. The trailing edge of the far left tip shows irregular structural losses/chips.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a secondary elongated biological structure (remora) attached near the center-right side of the median notch.
